scope: P-256 channel binding for sync payloads
problem: the sync transport authenticated with an Ed25519 seed stored in app data; copying that seed (root, forensic image, restored backup) was enough to impersonate a paired device even after the seed was wrapped by the Keystore

design.format: TWX2 | u16 spkiLen | SPKI | nonce[32] | u16 sigLen | ECDSA-SHA256 signature | u32 bodyLen | body
design.signed: domain | u16 senderP256 | u16 receiverP256 | nonce | SHA-256(body)
design.verify: SHA-256(SPKI) must equal the peer P-256 fingerprint stored at pairing (constant-time); signature over the fixed direction; nonce single-use within 5 minutes; max 4 MiB body
design.fail_closed: no payload is processed on failure; audit event sync_binding_rejected:<reason>

compatibility.code_based_sas_pairings: no P-256 fingerprint is available, so these pairings refuse to sync and ask for re-pairing by fingerprint
compatibility.legacy_peers: <=0.1.4 send raw payloads and are rejected with not_bound; both ends must be >=0.1.5

verification.host_tests: 94 pass, including test_transport_binding (valid envelope, other key, wrong expected fingerprint, tampered body, replayed nonce, reversed direction, legacy payload, truncated envelope)
verification.device: 0.1.5 installed on the Pixel 6a; schema 17 -> 18 migrated; audit page still reports 10 events chain intact; RUN_SUITE 48 / TASK_CENTER 10 / RUN_DOCUMENTS 20 PASS
verification.not_verified: no second physical device, so the cross-device bound exchange itself has not been executed end to end

known_gaps: pairing itself has no out-of-band MITM protection; the fingerprint path relies on the user comparing 64 hex characters
code-based pairing cannot bind P-256 until the pairing payload carries it
